summary: Call the product Fractal in CLI, terminal, web and Apple app display strings; introduce the Fractal Assistant display name.

schema.detail: No database, wire or schema changes.

rules.detail: No fleet or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: User-visible product labels now say Fractal. The built-in assistant display name is Fractal Assistant; its subject remains agent/st/assistant. Bundle IDs, CFBundleName, app paths, environment variables, service labels and stored-state fixtures are unchanged. Bundled onboarding prose has a new content revision; normal setup ownership and publication rules still apply.

downtime.detail: No service restart or state migration is required by this display-only change.

manual.detail: No configuration changes are needed. The iOS daily and dev display names are Fractal and Fractal Dev.

recovery.detail: Existing recovery and rollback procedures are unchanged.
